t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Mohal berde di labbinta ha dir berde an Allah an, a kesuna kala ku mi wadata dir herde an, wala wadowo bo sai an mo hisintammi. Der berde ma di labbinde a usatan ko dume ha berde am, ya an mo yidiyam hedi labbinde mangol ma, a holliyam gidol ma, de ni an on timitorde ku’a yidi. Defte warol ma di vonnatako waddi beldum ha dir berde an, an mo timminta be bo yokkowo do yukkol.
